replacement: One of the album's quieter references reaches much further back. On "Care for Somebody (Interlude)," Monét revisits "Somebody," a mid-century standard she first encountered as a child while watching *Introducing Dorothy Dandridge* with her grandmother. The connection stayed with her long enough that she later dressed as Dorothy Dandridge for Halloween twice.
